sloka: चन्द्र सूर्य अंशु संकाशः सागर अंबु समाश्रयः ।भ्राजते विपुलैः शृन्गैः अम्बरम् विलिखन् इव ॥४-४१-२९॥
transliteration: candra sūrya aṁśu saṁkāśaḥ sāgara aṁbu samāśrayaḥ ।bhrājate vipulaiḥ śṛngaiḥ ambaram vilikhan iva ॥4-41-29॥

translations.english: 'It looks bright, spreading its radiance like the Sun and Moon. It is surrounded by the sea. Its peaks appear as though scratching the sky.
